gaps.title: No ML-based recommendation models
gaps.description: DecisionEngine only supports rule_based algorithm. No regression, classification, time-series forecasting, or neural network models are implemented. The system cannot learn from historical data or adapt to changing conditions.
gaps.impact: Recommendations are static and cannot improve over time. No predictive capabilities for crop yield, disease outbreak, or resource optimization.
gaps.recommendation: Implement a model registry with pluggable ML models (e.g., RandomForest for yield prediction, LSTM for time-series forecasting, XGBoost for pest risk). Add model training pipeline, A/B testing framework, and model versioning.

gaps.title: No model explainability
gaps.description: Recommendations include no confidence scores, feature importance, or explanation of why a particular action is recommended.
gaps.impact: Users cannot trust or validate recommendations. No ability to debug why the system suggested a specific action.
gaps.recommendation: Integrate SHAP or LIME for local explainability. Add confidence intervals to predictions. Include top contributing factors in RecommendationResult.

gaps.title: No feature engineering or feature store
gaps.description: FarmState uses raw sensor values only. No derived features (e.g., growing degree days, soil moisture trend, VPD) are computed. No feature store for reuse across models.
gaps.impact: ML models would lack agronomically meaningful features. No consistency between training and serving features.
gaps.recommendation: Create a FeatureEngine class that computes derived agronomic features. Implement a feature store (e.g., Feast) for training/serving consistency.

gaps.title: No model training or retraining pipeline
gaps.description: No infrastructure for training models on historical data, evaluating performance, or deploying updated models.
gaps.impact: Models cannot be updated as new data becomes available. No continuous improvement loop.
gaps.recommendation: Add a training pipeline with automated retraining triggers (scheduled or drift-based). Implement model validation gates before deployment.

gaps.title: No A/B testing or model comparison framework
gaps.description: No ability to compare multiple models or algorithms side-by-side in production.
gaps.impact: Cannot validate that a new model outperforms the current one before full rollout.
gaps.recommendation: Implement an experimentation framework with traffic splitting, metric collection, and statistical significance testing.

gaps.title: No ML-based spoofing detection
gaps.description: GPSSpoofingDetector uses only rule-based heuristics (speed thresholds, position jumps, null island check). No ML models for pattern recognition or behavioral analysis.
gaps.impact: Sophisticated spoofing attacks that mimic normal patterns will not be detected. High false-positive rate for legitimate edge cases.
gaps.recommendation: Implement ML models (e.g., Isolation Forest, Autoencoder) trained on normal GPS patterns. Add behavioral profiling per device. Use ensemble methods combining rule-based and ML approaches.

gaps.title: No sensor fusion for spoofing detection
gaps.description: Only GPS data is analyzed. No integration with IMU, barometer, or other sensors that could corroborate or contradict GPS readings.
gaps.impact: Single-point failure. Spoofed GPS cannot be cross-validated against other sensor data.
gaps.recommendation: Implement sensor fusion algorithms (Kalman filter, particle filter) combining GPS with IMU, wheel odometry, and barometric altitude.

gaps.title: No historical pattern learning
gaps.description: Detector does not learn normal patterns per device or per route. Thresholds are static.
gaps.impact: Cannot adapt to different vehicle types, terrains, or operational patterns.
gaps.recommendation: Implement per-device behavioral profiling with online learning. Adjust thresholds based on historical normal behavior.

gaps.title: No actual notification channel implementations
gaps.description: NotificationChannel is a configuration dataclass only. The notify() method only logs messages — no email, SMS, push notification, webhook, or Slack/Teams integration is implemented.
gaps.impact: Alerts are never actually delivered to users. The notification system is non-functional.
gaps.recommendation: Implement concrete channel classes: EmailChannel (SMTP), SMSChannel (Twilio), PushChannel (FCM/APNs), WebhookChannel (HTTP POST), SlackChannel (Slack API). Use a strategy pattern for extensibility.

gaps.title: No alert deduplication or grouping
gaps.description: Every threshold violation creates a new alert. No deduplication for repeated violations of the same metric, no grouping of related alerts.
gaps.impact: Alert fatigue. Users receive hundreds of duplicate notifications for a single ongoing issue.
gaps.recommendation: Implement alert deduplication with configurable windows. Add alert grouping by farm, metric, or severity. Support alert aggregation (e.g., '5 soil moisture alerts in last hour').

gaps.title: No alert escalation policies
gaps.description: No escalation path if critical alerts are not acknowledged within a timeout. No on-call rotation integration.
gaps.impact: Critical alerts may be missed if the primary recipient is unavailable.
gaps.recommendation: Implement escalation policies with timeouts and recipient chains. Integrate with PagerDuty, Opsgenie, or similar incident management tools.

gaps.title: No customizable alert templates
gaps.description: Alert messages are hardcoded strings. No support for custom templates, localization, or user-defined message formats.
gaps.impact: Cannot adapt messaging for different audiences (agronomist vs. farm manager vs. regulator).
gaps.recommendation: Implement a template engine (Jinja2) for alert messages. Support per-channel templates and i18n.

gaps.title: No notification delivery confirmation or retry
gaps.description: No tracking of whether notifications were successfully delivered. No retry mechanism for failed deliveries.
gaps.impact: Silent notification failures. No way to audit whether critical alerts reached their recipients.
gaps.recommendation: Add delivery status tracking with retry logic (exponential backoff). Implement dead-letter queue for permanently failed notifications.

gaps.title: No quiet hours or notification scheduling
gaps.description: All alerts are sent immediately regardless of time of day or user preferences.
gaps.impact: User fatigue from non-critical alerts at night. No way to suppress low-priority notifications during off-hours.
gaps.recommendation: Implement quiet hours per channel per user. Add severity-based scheduling (critical = immediate, warning = business hours only).

gaps.title: No API request audit logging
gaps.description: No logging of who accessed what endpoint, when, with what parameters, and what response was returned. No request correlation IDs.
gaps.impact: Cannot investigate security incidents, debug issues, or demonstrate compliance. No traceability of data access.
gaps.recommendation: Implement structured audit logging for all API requests. Include timestamp, tenant_id, user_id, endpoint, method, request_id, response status, and latency. Use correlation IDs for distributed tracing.

gaps.title: No actuator command audit trail
gaps.description: Actuator commands (irrigation valves, machinery) are stored but not audited. No record of who issued the command, from where, or whether it was authorized.
gaps.impact: Cannot trace unauthorized or erroneous actuator operations. No accountability for physical actions taken by the system.
gaps.recommendation: Add comprehensive audit logging for all actuator commands. Include issuer identity, authorization check result, command parameters, and execution status.

gaps.title: No alert lifecycle audit trail
gaps.description: Alert state changes (created, acknowledged, resolved) are not logged with timestamps and actor identity.
gaps.impact: Cannot determine who acknowledged an alert or when it was resolved. No accountability for alert handling.
gaps.recommendation: Log all alert state transitions with timestamp, actor, and reason. Implement an immutable audit log for compliance.

gaps.title: No authentication event audit logging
gaps.description: Login attempts (successful and failed), token generation, and authorization decisions are not logged.
gaps.impact: Cannot detect brute-force attacks, investigate breaches, or demonstrate compliance with access control policies.
gaps.recommendation: Log all authentication and authentication events with timestamp, source IP, user agent, and outcome. Implement real-time alerting for suspicious patterns.

gaps.title: No user action audit trail
gaps.description: Dashboard state updates via WebSocket are not logged. No record of who changed what setting or when.
gaps.impact: Cannot trace configuration changes or investigate incidents caused by manual overrides.
gaps.recommendation: Log all state-changing operations with user identity, timestamp, before/after values, and source (WebSocket vs. API).

gaps.title: No spoofing event audit trail
gaps.description: Detected spoofing events are not logged or stored. No historical record of attacks or anomalies.
gaps.impact: Cannot analyze attack patterns, improve detection, or provide evidence for law enforcement.
gaps.recommendation: Log all spoofing detections with full context (reading, history, confidence, indicators). Implement a tamper-evident audit log.

gaps.title: No recommendation audit trail
gaps.description: Recommendations are not logged with the input state, output, and context. No way to replay or analyze past recommendations.
gaps.impact: Cannot analyze recommendation quality, debug issues, or demonstrate due diligence.
gaps.recommendation: Log all recommendations with input state, output, model version, and context. Implement a recommendation history API.

gaps.title: No data retention policies
gaps.description: No mechanism to automatically delete or archive old sensor readings, alerts, or audit logs. No retention period configuration.
gaps.impact: Unbounded data growth. Non-compliance with GDPR, CCPA, or agricultural data regulations.
gaps.recommendation: Implement configurable data retention policies per data type. Add automated data purging with audit trail of deletions.

gaps.title: No GDPR/data privacy compliance features
gaps.description: No data anonymization, right-to-erasure support, consent management, or data export functionality.
gaps.impact: Non-compliance with GDPR and similar regulations. Cannot fulfill data subject access requests.
gaps.recommendation: Implement data anonymization utilities, right-to-erasure endpoints, consent tracking, and data export (portability) functionality.

gaps.title: No password policy or credential management
gaps.description: No password complexity requirements, rotation policies, or secure credential storage. No integration with external identity providers.
gaps.impact: Weak credential security. No support for enterprise SSO requirements.
gaps.recommendation: Implement password policies, integrate with LDAP/Active Directory, support SAML/OIDC for enterprise SSO.

gaps.title: No MFA/TOTP support
gaps.description: Authentication is single-factor (JWT only). No multi-factor authentication support.
gaps.impact: Insufficient security for agricultural infrastructure. Single point of compromise if token is stolen.
gaps.recommendation: Implement TOTP-based MFA. Support hardware security keys (FIDO2/WebAuthn). Add MFA enforcement policies per tenant.

gaps.title: No rate limiting or DDoS protection
gaps.description: No rate limiting on API endpoints. No protection against denial-of-service attacks.
gaps.impact: System vulnerable to DDoS. No fair usage enforcement across tenants.
gaps.recommendation: Implement per-tenant and per-endpoint rate limiting. Add DDoS protection (e.g., Cloudflare integration, request throttling).

gaps.title: No regulatory reporting or compliance dashboards
gaps.description: No pre-built reports for regulatory compliance (e.g., pesticide usage, water consumption, environmental impact).
gaps.impact: Cannot easily demonstrate compliance with agricultural regulations. Manual report generation required.
gaps.recommendation: Implement configurable compliance report templates. Add scheduled report generation and distribution.

gaps.title: No geofencing or regulatory boundary compliance
gaps.description: No support for geofencing to ensure equipment stays within authorized areas. No integration with aviation or maritime regulations for autonomous vehicles.
gaps.impact: Cannot enforce operational boundaries. Potential regulatory violations for autonomous agricultural vehicles.
gaps.recommendation: Implement geofencing with configurable polygons. Add boundary violation alerts and automatic vehicle stop commands.

gaps.title: No data export for compliance or analysis
gaps.description: No ability to export sensor data, alerts, or recommendations in standard formats (CSV, JSON, PDF).
gaps.impact: Cannot provide data to regulators, auditors, or external analysis tools.
gaps.recommendation: Implement data export endpoints with filtering by date range, metric, and format. Add scheduled export jobs.

gaps.title: No multi-tenant isolation in dashboard
gaps.description: FarmDashboard has a single global state with no tenant_id. All WebSocket clients see the same farm state. No per-tenant dashboards.
gaps.impact: All tenants see each other's data. Complete data isolation failure.
gaps.recommendation: Add tenant_id to DashboardConfig. Create per-tenant dashboard instances. Enforce tenant isolation in WebSocket connections via JWT claims.

gaps.title: No multi-tenant isolation in alerts
gaps.description: AlertManager has no tenant_id on alerts, thresholds, or channels. All alerts are global.
gaps.impact: Alerts from one tenant visible to another. Cross-tenant data leakage.
gaps.recommendation: Add tenant_id to Alert, Threshold, and NotificationChannel. Scope all alert queries by tenant. Enforce tenant isolation in alert APIs.

gaps.title: No multi-tenant awareness in recommender
gaps.description: FarmState and RecommendationResult have no tenant_id. DecisionEngine cannot differentiate between tenants.
gaps.impact: Recommendations cannot be personalized per tenant. No tenant-specific model training or configuration.
gaps.recommendation: Add tenant_id to FarmState and RecommendationResult. Support per-tenant model configuration and training data isolation.

gaps.title: No tenant deletion cascade
gaps.description: Deleting a tenant does not delete associated farms, sensor readings, or actuator commands. Orphaned data remains.
gaps.impact: Data leakage after tenant deletion. Storage bloat from orphaned records.
gaps.recommendation: Implement cascade deletion when a tenant is deleted. Add data retention policy for deleted tenants.

gaps.title: No tenant-level rate limiting or quotas
gaps.description: No per-tenant rate limiting, storage quotas, or compute resource limits.
gaps.impact: One tenant can monopolize resources. No fair usage enforcement.
gaps.recommendation: Implement per-tenant rate limiting, storage quotas, and resource limits. Add tenant tier management (free, pro, enterprise).

gaps.title: No tenant context in authentication tokens
gaps.description: JWT tokens contain subject and roles but no tenant_id. Cannot enforce tenant-specific access control.
gaps.impact: A user with valid token can access any tenant's data. No tenant-level authorization.
gaps.recommendation: Add tenant_id to JWT claims. Implement tenant-aware authorization middleware. Support user membership in multiple tenants.

gaps.title: No multi-tenant awareness in GPS anti-spoofing
gaps.description: GPSSpoofingDetector has no tenant_id. Spoofing detection cannot be customized per tenant or per device fleet.
gaps.impact: Cannot apply different spoofing thresholds per tenant. No per-tenant spoofing history.
gaps.recommendation: Add tenant_id to GPSReading and spoofing detection results. Support per-tenant configuration of detection thresholds.

gaps.title: No tenant-specific configuration or customization
gaps.description: No support for tenant-specific thresholds, notification preferences, dashboard themes, or feature flags.
gaps.impact: All tenants get identical experience. No ability to customize per customer requirements.
gaps.recommendation: Implement a tenant configuration system with per-tenant settings. Support feature flags and gradual rollouts per tenant.

gaps.title: No cross-tenant data sharing controls
gaps.description: No mechanism for tenants to share data with each other (e.g., cooperative farms sharing weather data). No data sharing agreements or audit trail.
gaps.impact: Cannot support cooperative or consortium use cases. No controlled data sharing.
gaps.recommendation: Implement a data sharing framework with explicit consent, audit trail, and revocable permissions.

gaps.title: No authentication on API endpoints
gaps.description: None of the REST endpoints require authentication. No JWT validation, API key checking, or session management is integrated.
gaps.impact: Complete open access to all farm data and actuator commands. Critical security vulnerability.
gaps.recommendation: Integrate ZeroTrustAuth into all API endpoints. Require JWT tokens with appropriate roles. Implement API key authentication for device-to-device communication.

gaps.title: No authentication on WebSocket or REST endpoints
gaps.description: Dashboard WebSocket and REST endpoints have no authentication. Anyone can connect and view/modify farm state.
gaps.impact: Unauthorized access to real-time farm data and ability to send commands. Critical security vulnerability.
gaps.recommendation: Add JWT authentication to WebSocket handshake. Require authentication on all REST endpoints. Implement role-based access control.

gaps.title: No token revocation or blacklist mechanism
gaps.description: JWT tokens cannot be revoked before expiration. No blacklist for compromised tokens.
gaps.impact: Stolen tokens remain valid until expiration. No way to quickly revoke access.
gaps.recommendation: Implement a token blacklist (Redis-backed) for revoked tokens. Add refresh token rotation. Support emergency token revocation.

gaps.title: No role hierarchy or permission-based access control
gaps.description: Only flat role checking is supported. No role hierarchy (e.g., admin > operator > viewer) or fine-grained permissions.
gaps.impact: Cannot express complex authorization policies. Over-privileged users.
gaps.recommendation: Implement role inheritance and permission-based access control (PBAC). Support resource-level permissions (e.g., 'farm:read', 'farm:write').

gaps.title: Only linear regression model implemented
gaps.description: ml_models.py contains only LinearRegressionModel. No classification, clustering, time-series forecasting, or anomaly detection models. Agricultural decision support requires classification (disease/pest identification), forecasting (yield prediction, weather), and anomaly detection (sensor fault detection).
gaps.impact: Cannot support critical agronomic use cases like disease classification, yield forecasting, or sensor anomaly detection.
gaps.recommendation: Add DecisionTree/RandomForest for classification, ARIMA/Prophet for time-series forecasting, and IsolationForest for anomaly detection. Implement a model registry pattern.

gaps.title: No model persistence or serialization
gaps.description: Models cannot be saved to or loaded from disk. Every restart requires retraining from scratch. No support for pickle, joblib, ONNX, or other serialization formats.
gaps.impact: Production deployments cannot maintain trained models across restarts. No model versioning or rollback capability.
gaps.recommendation: Add save()/load() methods to SimpleMLModel ABC. Support pickle and joblib formats. Implement model versioning with metadata.

gaps.title: No model evaluation metrics beyond R-squared
gaps.description: Only R² is computed for regression. No accuracy, precision, recall, F1, AUC-ROC for classification. No MAE, RMSE, MAPE for regression. No cross-validation support.
gaps.impact: Cannot properly evaluate model performance or compare models. No confidence in production predictions.
gaps.recommendation: Add comprehensive metrics module. Implement k-fold cross-validation. Add classification and regression metric suites.

gaps.title: No feature engineering pipeline
gaps.description: No feature scaling, normalization, encoding, or selection. Raw features fed directly to models. No handling of missing values or outliers.
gaps.impact: Model performance degraded. No reproducibility in feature preparation.
gaps.recommendation: Add preprocessing pipeline with StandardScaler, MinMaxScaler, OneHotEncoder. Implement feature selection methods.

gaps.title: No model registry or experiment tracking
gaps.description: No centralized registry for trained models. No experiment tracking, hyperparameter logging, or model comparison.
gaps.impact: Cannot manage multiple model versions or track experiments.
gaps.recommendation: Implement ModelRegistry class with versioning, metadata storage, and model comparison capabilities.

gaps.title: No hyperparameter tuning
gaps.description: No grid search, random search, or Bayesian optimization for model hyperparameters.
gaps.impact: Suboptimal model performance.
gaps.recommendation: Add hyperparameter tuning module with grid search and random search.

gaps.title: No ensemble methods
gaps.description: No bagging, boosting, or stacking implementations. Only single models supported.
gaps.impact: Limited predictive power for complex agronomic patterns.
gaps.recommendation: Add RandomForest, GradientBoosting, and stacking ensemble implementations.

gaps.title: No online/incremental learning support
gaps.description: Models cannot be updated incrementally with new data. Only batch training supported.
gaps.impact: Cannot adapt to changing conditions without full retraining.
gaps.recommendation: Add partial_fit() method for online learning algorithms.

gaps.title: Missing push notification channels (FCM/APNs)
gaps.description: No Firebase Cloud Messaging or Apple Push Notification support. Mobile app users cannot receive push notifications.
gaps.impact: Mobile users miss critical alerts. No push notification delivery tracking.
gaps.recommendation: Add FCMNotification and APNsNotification channels with token management.

gaps.title: Missing chat platform integrations (Slack, Telegram, Discord)
gaps.description: No Slack, Telegram, or Discord webhook/chat integrations. Teams cannot receive alerts in their collaboration tools.
gaps.impact: Teams cannot monitor farm alerts from chat platforms.
gaps.recommendation: Add SlackNotification, TelegramNotification, and DiscordNotification channels.

gaps.title: No notification templates or localization
gaps.description: No template engine for notifications. No i18n/l10n support. All messages are plain text.
gaps.impact: Cannot provide rich, localized notifications for diverse user bases.
gaps.recommendation: Add template engine with variable substitution and multi-language support.

gaps.title: No priority-based routing or escalation
gaps.description: All notifications treated equally. No escalation policies (e.g., if critical alert not acknowledged in 5 min, escalate to manager).
gaps.impact: Critical alerts may be missed. No escalation path for unacknowledged alerts.
gaps.recommendation: Add priority-based routing with escalation policies and on-call scheduling.

gaps.title: No delivery confirmation or read receipts
gaps.description: No tracking of delivery status beyond sent/failed. No read receipts or acknowledgment tracking.
gaps.impact: Cannot confirm critical alerts were received and read.
gaps.recommendation: Add delivery confirmation callbacks and read receipt tracking.

gaps.title: No batch or digest notifications
gaps.description: No support for batching multiple alerts into a single digest. Each alert sent individually.
gaps.impact: Alert fatigue from too many individual notifications.
gaps.recommendation: Add digest/batching mode with configurable intervals.

gaps.title: No notification scheduling or quiet hours
gaps.description: No support for scheduled notifications or quiet hours (do-not-disturb periods).
gaps.impact: Users receive notifications at inappropriate times.
gaps.recommendation: Add scheduling with timezone support and quiet hours configuration.

gaps.title: No SMS fallback for failed push notifications
gaps.description: No automatic fallback from push to SMS when push delivery fails.
gaps.impact: Critical alerts may be missed if push notifications fail.
gaps.recommendation: Add fallback chain: push -> SMS -> email with configurable order.

gaps.title: Audit logs stored only in memory
gaps.description: AuditLogger stores events in a Python list. All audit data lost on restart. No persistence to disk, database, or external system.
gaps.impact: No long-term audit trail for compliance. Data loss on crash or restart.
gaps.recommendation: Add persistent storage backends: file-based (JSONL), PostgreSQL, Elasticsearch. Implement log rotation.

gaps.title: No audit log export or reporting
gaps.description: Only JSON export available. No CSV, PDF, or compliance report generation. No scheduled reports.
gaps.impact: Cannot generate compliance reports for auditors.
gaps.recommendation: Add export formats (CSV, PDF) and scheduled compliance report generation.

gaps.title: No audit log search or filtering by date range
gaps.description: get_events() supports filtering by type, tenant, actor but not by date range or full-text search.
gaps.impact: Difficult to investigate incidents or generate time-bounded reports.
gaps.recommendation: Add date range filtering and full-text search capabilities.

gaps.title: No tamper detection alerts
gaps.description: verify_chain() exists but is never called automatically. No alerts when tampering is detected.
gaps.impact: Tampering may go undetected.
gaps.recommendation: Add periodic chain verification with alerting on failure.

gaps.title: No audit log archival
gaps.description: No archival of old audit logs. All events kept in memory indefinitely.
gaps.impact: Memory growth over time. No long-term retention.
gaps.recommendation: Add archival policy with configurable retention periods.

gaps.title: No audit log integrity verification scheduling
gaps.description: No background task to periodically verify chain integrity.
gaps.impact: Tampering detection is manual only.
gaps.recommendation: Add scheduled integrity verification with configurable intervals.

gaps.title: No audit log compression
gaps.description: No compression of audit log data for storage efficiency.
gaps.impact: Increased storage costs.
gaps.recommendation: Add compression for archived logs.

recommendations_priority.action: Implement authentication and authorization on all API and dashboard endpoints
Add multi-tenant isolation across all modules
Add comprehensive audit logging across all modules
Implement ML model framework for recommendations and spoofing detection
Add compliance features (data retention, GDPR, regulatory reporting)
Harden security (token revocation, MFA, RBAC hierarchy)
